cases.why: the smallest record there is: four required keys and a body
reply_to and meta.trace are optional and survive a round trip
an acknowledgement is an ordinary event record
presence is an ordinary event record on the presence address
command is a known type in both implementations, not just one
the known set is a convention, not an allow-list: neither side rejects a novel type
meta is open and unknown top-level fields are preserved
a version this build does not implement is refused by name, on both sides
a record is a JSON object
a publisher may not write an event record with no event; a reader tolerates what it did not write
to is required: it names the stream the record belongs to
